summary: Greenbriar Sustainable Living Inc., a Canadian real estate issuer, furnished a Form 6-K containing unaudited interim financial statements and MD&A for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026. The report shows a net loss of about CAD 1.96 million for Q2 2026 and CAD 3.03 million for the half, with going-concern language and various liabilities including convertible debentures and a joint-venture settlement obligation. No special-situations transaction (acquisition, divestiture, tender, spin-off, etc.) is described. This is a routine periodic financial report by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to an ordinary quarterly update, with no deal terms or board recommendation to classify as a special situation.
